gaps.title: Display Moodle Role Hierarchy Mappings in UI
gaps.jtbd: When an administrator accesses the role management interface, I want to see the current Moodle role hierarchy mappings, so that I can inspect and manage how Moodle user roles translate into archive permissions.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an authenticated administrator, When navigating to the Moodle role management interface, Then the frontend should fetch GET /api/v1/auth/moodle/override-role and render the Moodle role hierarchy mappings.
gaps.reason: Literal brief requirement: item 2 explicitly requires 'отображение иерархии ролей Moodle в ролевую модель архива', but the frontend currently only provides an individual user role override control without displaying the Moodle role pattern mapping hierarchy.
